_comment: Baseline for scripts/check_plugin_standard.py — the KNOWN plugin-contract violations, being repaid over time. Fix one and remove its entry in the same change. Only ever remove entries; never add. Regenerate deliberately with --save.

_rules.structure.init: __init__.py is missing — the directory is not a Python package
_rules.structure.manifest: app.py must define a MorpheusPlugin subclass
_rules.manifest.name: manifest `name` must equal the directory name
_rules.manifest.label: manifest `label` is required (merchant-facing name)
_rules.graph.requires_unknown: `requires` names an app that does not exist
_rules.models.migrations_package: migrations/ exists without __init__.py — Django cannot see it
_rules.models.migrations_missing: models are defined but there is no migrations/ package
_rules.models.has_models_flag: models are defined but the manifest does not set has_models = True
_rules.tests.missing: no tests — at least one test module is required
